item.title: From Covington to the World Stage: NCCA VEX Robotics Team earns top state ranking
item.description: With a season defined by championships, top honors, and global rankings, VEX Robotics Team 8682A from Newton College and Career Academy has emerged as the top-ranked team in the state of Georgia and one of the most competitive student robotics teams in the world.

item.title: Covington council sending tax plan to state legislators for review
item.description: In a unanimous decision, the Covington City Council voted on Jan. 20 to send a plan to impose a full homestead tax exemption on the city to state legislators for review.

item.title: Group meets in protest of rumored Social Circle ICE center
item.description: An estimated 80 people, many affiliated with area progressive groups, met last Wednesday in Oxford to begin planning the next steps in opposition to a federal Immigration & Customs Enforcement (ICE) detention center that might possibly be established in an existing 1-million-plus square-foot warehouse in Social Circle, potentially housing from 5,000 to 10,000 detainees awaiting deportation.

item.title: Sable Circle house fire displaces four
item.description: A home on Sable Circle was deemed a total loss after a Monday night fire that reportedly displaced four people.

item.title: Mike Collins requests briefing with DHS, ICE over rumored Social Circle facility
item.description: Tenth Congressional District Representative and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate Mike Collins is reportedly looking to meet with federal officials about a rumored Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) detention facility in Social Circle.The facility, which reports say would likely be able to hold 5,000-10,000 detainees staged for deportation, has been a talking point amongst citizens and politicians alike in recent weeks. item.title: Alana Sanders receives Rev. Joseph E. Lowery Civil Rights Award at Georgia State Capitol
item.description: The annual Celebration of Service, hosted by the Georgia Martin Luther King Jr. Advisory Council, honored individuals whose leadership reflects the principles of justice, equity, and service championed by Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. and the late Rev. Joseph E. Lowery.

item.title: HARRIS: Putting your aging parents' wishes first
item.description: As your parents grow older, it may be time to talk with them about financial and aging issues, which may involve difficult conversations.

item.title: VELIOTIS: The ‘skinny’ on sandwiches
item.description: I have had many brilliant ideas, most of which ended up in the dreams ‘discard’ pile. Don’t you think this would be a success???? I wager that you eat sandwiches ALMOST EVERY DAY?

item.title: Woman charged in crash that injured two paramedics
item.description: The woman believed to be responsible for a vehicle crash in late October that left two paramedics with serious injuries has been arrested and charged.

item.title: Newton County Schools students to compete in district Spelling Bee
item.description: Newton County School System students will soon compete to determine who is the best speller in the county when they face off at the district Spelling Bee on Friday, Jan. 30 at 10 a.m. at Porter Performing Arts Center. Champions from elementary and middle schools in the district will compete in the competition. Students in grades third through eighth were eligible to participate in their school competitions.
